usage.outputShape: body.keywords[] (array of keyword strings), body.processedAt (ISO timestamp)
quirks: Input field is 'text' (a string seed/topic), NOT 'keyword' — sending {keyword:...} returns 400 'Validation failed: field text expected string, received undefined'. inputSchema was null in the registry.

Output is thin: for seed 'coffee' it returned only {keywords:['coffee']} — i.e. it echoed the seed back as a 1-element array rather than producing related/expanded keyword ideas. Useful keyword expansion was not observed for a single-word seed.
Response confirmed:false / txHash:null but payment settled (paid:true, status 200).
usage.guide: Call POST https://gg402.vercel.app/keywords with a JSON body {"text":"<seed keyword or topic>"} and pay the $0.01 x402 charge (USDC on Base). The field MUST be named 'text' — 'keyword' or other names return a 400 validation error. On success you get a sync 200 with {"keywords":[...],"processedAt":"<iso>"}; read the keyword ideas from body.keywords[]. Note that for a short single-word seed the service may just echo the seed back, so expect possibly limited expansion.
